article_context: 讨论欧盟女性董事配额：作者不喜欢配额本身，却认为在长期结构性障碍存在时可能需要暂时性制度安排。主讲人采用锋利但克制的社会评论语气。

article.title: 阅读四 · 女性董事配额与任人唯贤
article.background: 讨论欧盟女性董事配额：作者不喜欢配额本身，却认为在长期结构性障碍存在时可能需要暂时性制度安排。主讲人采用锋利但克制的社会评论语气。

sentences.en: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven.
sentences.zh: 欧洲并不是性别平等的天堂。

segments.text: Europe is not a gender-equality heaven.

sentences.en: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.
sentences.zh: 尤其是在企业职场中，只有女性能够参与高层管理决策，工作场所才可能真正做到家庭友好；而欧洲企业治理的最高职位仍然几乎由男性占据。

segments.text: In particular, the corporate workplace will never be completely family-friendly until women are part of senior management decisions, and Europe's top corporate-governance positions remain overwhelmingly male.

sentences.en: Indeed, women hold only 14 per cent of positions on European corporate boards.
sentences.zh: 事实上，欧洲公司董事会中女性所占的职位比例只有14%。

segments.text: Indeed, women hold only 14 per cent of positions on European corporate boards.

sentences.en: The European Union is now considering legislation to compel corporate boards to maintain a certain proportion of women - up to 60 per cent.
sentences.zh: 欧盟目前正在考虑通过立法，强制公司董事会保持一定比例的女性成员，比例最高可达60%。

segments.text: The European Union is now considering legislation to compel corporate boards to maintain a certain proportion of women - up to 60 per cent.

sentences.en: This proposed mandate was born of frustration.
sentences.zh: 这项拟议中的强制规定源于挫败感。

segments.text: This proposed mandate was born of frustration.

sentences.en: Last year, European Commission Vice President Viviane Reding issued a call to voluntary action.
sentences.zh: 去年，欧盟委员会副主席维维亚娜·雷丁曾发出自愿行动的倡议。

segments.text: Last year, European Commission Vice President Viviane Reding issued a call to voluntary action.

sentences.en: Reding invited corporations to sign up for gender balance goals of 40 per cent female board membership.
sentences.zh: 雷丁邀请各公司签署承诺，将董事会中女性成员的比例目标设为40%。

segments.text: Reding invited corporations to sign up for gender balance goals of 40 per cent female board membership.

sentences.en: But her appeal was considered a failure: only 24 companies took it up.
sentences.zh: 但她的呼吁被认为失败了：只有24家公司响应。

segments.text: But her appeal was considered a failure: only 24 companies took it up.

sentences.en: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?
sentences.zh: 为了确保女性在兼顾工作和家庭的同时仍能公平地沿着企业晋升阶梯向上走，我们是否需要配额制度？

segments.text: Do we need quotas to ensure that women can continue to climb the corporate ladder fairly as they balance work and family?

sentences.en: "Personally, I don't like quotas," Reding said recently.
sentences.zh: 雷丁最近说：“就我个人而言，我不喜欢配额。”

segments.text: "Personally, I don't like quotas," Reding said recently.

sentences.en: "But I like what the quotas do."

segments.text: "But I like what the quotas do."

sentences.en: Quotas get action: they "open the way to equality and they break through the glass ceiling," according to Reding, a result seen in France and other countries with legally binding provisions on placing women in top business positions.
sentences.zh: 配额会促成行动：据雷丁所说，它们“为平等打开道路，并打破玻璃天花板”；法国和其他对女性进入企业高层实行具有法律约束力规定的国家已经出现了这种结果。

segments.text: Quotas get action: they "open the way to equality and they break through the glass ceiling," according to Reding, a result seen in France and other countries with legally binding provisions on placing women in top business positions.

sentences.en: I understand Reding's reluctance - and her frustration.
sentences.zh: 我理解雷丁的不情愿，也理解她的挫败感。

segments.text: I understand Reding's reluctance - and her frustration.

sentences.en: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.
sentences.zh: 我也不喜欢配额；它违背我信奉的任人唯贤原则，也就是由有能力者治理。

segments.text: I don't like quotas either; they run counter to my belief in meritocracy, governance by the capable.

sentences.en: But, when one considers the obstacles to achieving the meritocratic ideal, it does look as if a fairer world must be temporarily ordered.
sentences.zh: 但是，考虑到实现这种任人唯贤理想所面临的障碍，看起来一个更公平的世界暂时还必须借助制度性安排来实现。

segments.text: But, when one considers the obstacles to achieving the meritocratic ideal, it does look as if a fairer world must be temporarily ordered.

sentences.en: After all, four decades of evidence has now shown that corporations in Europe as well as the US are evading the meritocratic hiring and promotion of women to top positions - no matter how much "soft pressure" is put upon them.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，四十年来的证据已经表明，无论在欧洲还是美国，企业都在回避按照能力公平地招聘和晋升女性进入高层职位——不管对它们施加多少“软性压力”。

segments.text: After all, four decades of evidence has now shown that corporations in Europe as well as the US are evading the meritocratic hiring and promotion of women to top positions - no matter how much "soft pressure" is put upon them.

sentences.en: When women do break through to the summit of corporate power - as, for example, Sheryl Sandberg recently did at Facebook - they attract massive attention precisely because they remain the exception to the rule.
sentences.zh: 当女性确实突破障碍、登上企业权力顶峰时——比如谢丽尔·桑德伯格最近在脸书做到的那样——她们会引来巨大的关注，恰恰因为她们仍然是规则之外的例外。

segments.text: When women do break through to the summit of corporate power - as, for example, Sheryl Sandberg recently did at Facebook - they attract massive attention precisely because they remain the exception to the rule.

sentences.en: If appropriate public policies were in place to help all women - whether CEOs or their children's caregivers - and all families, Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person living in a more just society.
sentences.zh: 如果有适当的公共政策帮助所有女性——无论是CEO，还是她们孩子的照护者——以及所有家庭，那么桑德伯格就不会比生活在一个更公正社会里的其他高能力者更有新闻价值。

segments.text: If appropriate public policies were in place to help all women - whether CEOs or their children's caregivers - and all families, Sandberg would be no more newsworthy than any other highly capable person living in a more just society.
